_comment: Core Keeper LanguageDataBlock address->ISO6391 table. Captured 2026-06-04 via a one-time runtime dump (ScriptableData.GetDataBlocks<LanguageDataBlock>()) from game 1.2.1.4-7f74, because these blocks are runtime-only data (absent in the editor, edit-mode AND batchmode). Used by the Option-II localisation generator to template native TextDataBlock .asset files at build time. Stable game data; re-dump only if a CK update changes the language set. 'low'/'high' are DataBlockAddress.lowBits/highBits (the two halves of the address GUID). Primary language = order 0 (en).
